[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1911 census household list names Hannah Glasgow, aged 70, as the widowed mother of the head, Amy Isabel Glasgow, at Elephant & Castle, 1 Merchant Street, Bristol, England. Hannah’s birthplace is indexed as Bradford, Yorkshire. The same household list appears on the four companion entries. National Archives reference RG 14/14875, enumeration district 14.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/2352/records/55637653 Ancestry, 1911 England Census: Hannah Glasgow, RG 14/14875, record 2352/55637653].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The census identifies this resident in the Bristol household. Birth surname and earlier identity remain unresolved.
